dedupe_keys.name: submergence of floating concrete docks at crescent city harbor during the 2025 kamchatka tsunami

description: Submergence of Floating Concrete Docks at Crescent City Harbor during the 2025 Kamchatka Tsunami is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Patrick Lynett, University of Southern California (usc.edu). This project documents and analyzes a rare tsunami‐induced failure mode observed at Crescent City Harbor, CA, during the 29 July 2025 Kamchatka event: the temporary submergence (sinking without breakup) of large concrete floating dock modules. Coverage: Crescent City, CA. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: tsunami,  marina,  harbor, damage. Published 2025-08-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
